opportunities.name: Family call email with local time and weather
opportunities.description: For a relative in a given city, look up that city's current time on timeanddate.com and its 10-day forecast on weather.com, then draft an email to family@example.com about the call on a given day.
steps: On timeanddate.com, search for {city} and open the matching city result
Note the current local time, time zone and offset from Lille
On weather.com, open location search, type {city}, pick the matching suggestion
Open the '10 Day' tab and note the {day} forecast (conditions, high, low, chance of rain)
In mail, compose: To = family@example.com, Subject = 'Call with {relative} on {day}'
Body = 'Calling {relative} on {day}. It is {time} {tz} in {city} now ({offset} Lille), forecast there: {conditions} {day}, high {high}, low {low}, {rain}% chance of rain.'
Discard the draft (save or send in a real run)

opportunities.name: Weekend stopover research and hotel note
opportunities.description: For a French city and weekend dates, check the city on Wikipedia (population, main sight), search Booking.com for a one-night stay on those dates, pick a hotel, and save a stopover note.
steps: On Wikipedia, search {city} and note the population and a main sight
On Booking.com, clear the destination box, type {city}, pick the matching suggestion
Open the date picker, go forward to the right month if needed, and select {checkin} and {checkout}
Click Search and open the chosen hotel result
Note the hotel name and price

instances.values: city=Dijon, dates=Nov 21-22 2026, hotel=Aparthotel Adagio Access Dijon République €69
city=Reims, dates=Dec 19-20 2026, hotel=Best Western Premier Hotel de la Paix €204

opportunities.name: Dinner options: restaurant vs. recipe note
opportunities.description: Search a restaurant site for a cuisine in a London area and an Allrecipes recipe for a matching dish, then save a note comparing eating out with cooking.
steps: On the restaurant site, clear the search box, type '{cuisine} {area}' and submit
Open a restaurant result and note its name, rating, price band and area
On Allrecipes, open search, type {dish} and submit
Open the top recipe result and note its total time
In notes, add 'Dinner: out at {restaurant} ({rating}, {price}, {area}) or cook {recipe} ({time})'

instances.values: Italian Islington -> Terra Rossa - Angel; dish=lasagna -> Creamy Chicken Lasagna
Thai Soho -> Thai Tho - Soho; dish=pad thai -> Pad Thai
Indian Shoreditch -> SPICE SLICE Shoreditch; dish=chicken tikka masala -> Chicken Tikka Masala
